finding: Slovak firms see stronger upside inflation risk than euro area peers
bullets: A net 62.25% of Slovak firms (n=194) saw upside risks to five-year inflation, exceeding the euro area's net 55.37% (n=4,881) by 6.9 pp, consistent with local price persistence.
The Slovak upside inflation risk balance rose marginally from a net 61.23% in the previous wave, with the euro area also ticking up from net 54.04%.
German firms moved in the opposite direction, with the upside inflation risk balance easing by 2.25 pp to a net 49.08%, below both Slovakia and the euro area.
chart_subtitle: Net 62.25% of Slovak firms see upside inflation risks.
